name: Desktop 3-DOF Robot Arm, 1 kg @ 400 mm
description: Desktop arm with three joints: base yaw (J1), shoulder pitch (J2) and elbow pitch (J3), plus a parallel gripper. Shoulder-to-elbow is 220 mm and elbow-to-grip-centre is 180 mm, so it reaches 400 mm. Stepper motors with planetary gearboxes. Shown in the worst case: arm level and fully stretched along +x.

parts.name: Base plate
parts.purpose: Footprint and four M6 desk-clamp holes; must be clamped (tips at about 3.2 Nm otherwise)

parts.name: Turntable housing
parts.purpose: Holds the J1 slewing bearing and the 5:1 belt pulley

parts.name: J1 yaw stepper NEMA17
parts.purpose: Drives base yaw through a 5:1 GT2 belt

parts.name: Controller + drivers
parts.purpose: MCU and four stepper drivers, 24 V

parts.name: Shoulder yoke
parts.purpose: Carries the J2 bearing pair and output flange

parts.name: J2 shoulder NEMA23 + 10:1 planetary
parts.purpose: About 15 Nm geared holding torque against about 7 Nm worst-case gravity torque

parts.name: Elbow block
parts.purpose: Holds the J3 bearing and gearbox output

parts.name: J3 elbow NEMA17 + 15:1 planetary
parts.purpose: About 5 Nm geared torque against about 2.5 Nm needed

parts.name: Forearm tube
parts.purpose: Link 2, 180 mm from elbow to grip centre

parts.name: Gripper body + servo
parts.purpose: Rack-and-pinion parallel jaw driven by a 25 kg·cm servo

parts.name: Finger left
parts.purpose: Jaw with rubber pad; 0 to 60 mm opening

parts.name: Steel ballast plate
parts.purpose: Counterweight under the reach side, lowers tipping risk

assembly.action: Stick rubber feet under the aluminium plate, bolt the steel ballast under the reach side, and clamp the plate to the desk with four M6 bolts
Screw the turntable housing to the plate and fit the J1 slewing bearing
Mount the J1 motor, fit the pulley and tension the GT2 belt
Fit the controller with its driver modules, wire the e-stop and DC jack, and run the harness into the housing
Bolt the yoke to the bearing; flange on the NEMA23 gearbox, horn and cover
Clamp the tube between the shoulder and elbow blocks and screw on both side plates
Mount the J3 motor, horn and elbow cover
Fit the forearm to the J3 output with its side plates
Attach the gripper and servo; fit the jaws and bond on the rubber pads
Route the cables along the links and clip them every 35 to 50 mm
